prior_history.issue_verbatim: The last exercise looks darker, but scan darkness is not sufficient to declare intentional full-line bold or exact endpoints. Essential comparison crop required.
Exercise7 is darker, but its serif shapes and variable darkness of preceding exercises do not establish an intentional bold span or reliable endpoints. No certain heavy span is asserted.

new_observations: The stored exercise focus contains six actual exercises2 through7. It was opened once for comparison, not for retranscription or math solving.

The additional native-resolution crop contains exercise6's two lines and exercise7's single line. It is an unchanged-pixel rectangular crop of the original source, with no resizing, contrast adjustment, thresholding, sharpening, or retyping.

Exercise7 is darker in some glyphs, especially the diagonal numeral7 and some body strokes. Its Chinese glyphs remain serif-shaped with contrasting thin horizontal strokes and heavier vertical/oblique strokes.

The repeated 长, 光, 米, 的 and 动 shapes in exercise7 versus adjacent exercise6 retain comparable serif terminals and thin-stroke/thick-stroke contrast. There is no clear transition to a uniformly heavy, comparatively monoline face.
Ink density also varies within the adjacent comparison text. Different numerals6 and7 cannot alone establish a face change because their stroke structures differ.

These observations are consistent with normal serif printing and uneven ink density, but do not establish confirmed-normal weight to independent-review certainty. A darker serif heavy face cannot be excluded from these original pixels alone.
No exact start/end of an intentional heavy span, or membership of the numeral, formula, comma, or final period, can be asserted with certainty.
